note: 66 NEW animation primitives for the Prism Animatable catalog (toward 300). None duplicate the existing 24. category is one of the 15 in contract.ts. exportName = camelCase(name)+'Primitive'. Batches A-D.

A.name: flip
A.label: Flip
A.subject: card
A.description: Card flips in on its Y axis, easing from a 3/4 turn edge-on to face the viewer while fading in.
A.behavior: rotation.y eases from ~Math.PI*0.85 to 0 over duration; opacity rises 0->1 with the eased phase. Controls: duration (fader), axis (dropdown x|y), curve (curve). Reading axis live picks rotation.x vs rotation.y.

A.name: bounce
A.label: Bounce In
A.subject: card
A.description: Card drops in from above and settles with a physical bounce.
A.behavior: position.y goes from +height to base using bounceOut easing; opacity rises early. Controls: duration (fader), height (fader 1..5), bounces handled by easing. Use ease('bounceOut', phase).

A.name: elastic
A.label: Elastic In
A.subject: card
A.description: Card springs to full scale with an elastic overshoot wobble.
A.behavior: scale (uniform) goes 0 -> 1 via elasticOut; opacity rises. Controls: duration (fader), overshoot/amplitude (knob scaling the elastic deviation), curve fixed elasticOut. scale must overshoot >1 mid-phase then settle to 1.

A.name: overshoot
A.label: Overshoot Slide
A.subject: card
A.description: Card slides in past its target then eases back with a backOut overshoot.
A.behavior: position.x travels from -distance to 0 using backOut (overshoots beyond 0 then returns); opacity rises. Controls: duration (fader), distance (fader), angleDeg (knob). Distinct from slide: uses backOut overshoot, observable position beyond target mid-phase.

A.name: rotate-in
A.label: Rotate In
A.subject: card
A.description: Card spins in from a tilted angle to upright while fading and scaling up.
A.behavior: rotation.z from -angle (e.g. -120deg) to 0; scale 0.6->1; opacity 0->1, all eased. Controls: duration (fader), angleDeg (knob -180..180), curve (curve).

A.name: swing
A.label: Swing
A.subject: card
A.description: Card swings like a pendulum from a pivot, oscillation damping to rest.
A.behavior: rotation.z = amplitude * exp(-decay*phase) * cos(freq*phase*2PI); continuous-ish but settles. duration finite. Controls: duration (fader), amplitudeDeg (knob), frequency (knob). rotation differs between t=0 and t=mid.

A.name: float
A.label: Float
A.subject: card
A.description: Card gently bobs and drifts in a continuous idle float loop.
A.behavior: Looping (duration Infinity): position.y = sin(t*speed)*amp; small rotation.z = sin(t*speed*0.7)*tilt. Controls: speed (knob), amplitude (fader), tiltDeg (knob). position.y differs across seek times.

A.name: jelly
A.label: Jelly
A.subject: card
A.description: Card squashes and stretches with a wobbling jelly settle on entrance.
A.behavior: Non-uniform scale: scale.x and scale.y oscillate out of phase (squash-stretch) with decaying amplitude, settling to 1; opacity rises. Controls: duration (fader), wobble (knob amplitude), frequency (knob). scale.x != scale.y mid-phase.

A.name: flash
A.label: Flash In
A.subject: card
A.description: Card flashes in with a bright emissive spike that settles to its base look.
A.behavior: opacity 0->1 fast; emissiveIntensity on materials spikes (e.g. 0->2->base) over phase. Controls: duration (fader), peak (knob emissive peak), curve (curve). Track emissiveIntensity on a found material; restore in dispose. Use materialsOf-style traversal.

A.name: blink
A.label: Blink
A.subject: card
A.description: Card blinks its opacity in a steady loop, like a status indicator.
A.behavior: Looping (Infinity): opacity = floor or smooth between min and 1 based on sin(t*speed). Controls: speed (knob), minOpacity (fader 0..0.8), smooth (toggle hard vs smooth). opacity differs across seek times.

A.name: fade-through-black
A.label: Fade Through Black
A.subject: card
A.description: Card fades out to nothing then fades back in — a classic transition dip.
A.behavior: opacity follows abs(2*phase-1) inverted: 1 at ends, dips toward minOpacity at phase 0.5. Controls: duration (fader), dip (fader min opacity at midpoint), curve (curve). opacity at mid < opacity at start.

A.name: dissolve-noise
A.label: Noise Dissolve
A.subject: card
A.description: Card materializes by a per-fragment noise threshold sweeping its alpha from 0 to full.
A.behavior: TSL: swap subject.material to a MeshStandardNodeMaterial (from three/webgpu) with an opacityNode = step(noise(uv*scale), uThreshold) style alpha driven by a uThreshold uniform advanced in seek 0->1. Use three/tsl (uv, mx_noise or sin-based fbm, step/smoothstep, uniform). Track uThreshold.value as the observable; assert it changes across seek. Restore prevMat in dispose. Cast colorNode/opacityNode like caustics.ts.

A.name: sticky-pin
A.label: Sticky Pin
A.subject: card
A.description: Card pins in place across a scroll band, then releases and continues — a scroll-pinned section.
A.behavior: Reads target.userData.scroll (0..1). Below pinStart: translate with scroll; within [pinStart,pinEnd]: held fixed (pinned); above: translate again. position.y derived from scroll outside the band. Controls: pinStart (fader), pinEnd (fader), travel (fader). seek(t) maps t->scroll if userData.scroll absent. Observable: position.y constant within band, changing outside.

A.name: horizontal-scroll
A.label: Horizontal Scroll
A.subject: card
A.description: Vertical scroll drives the card horizontally — the horizontal-gallery effect.
A.behavior: Reads userData.scroll (0..1); position.x = lerp(startX, endX, scroll). Controls: distance (fader), direction (dropdown ltr|rtl), ease (curve). position.x changes with scroll. Fallback scroll = phase(t).

A.name: reveal-mask-scroll
A.label: Reveal On Scroll
A.subject: card
A.description: Scroll wipes the card into view, scaling up from a clipped sliver to full with a fade.
A.behavior: Reads userData.scroll; scale.y (or scale.x per axis) goes from 0.05 to 1 and opacity 0->1 as scroll crosses [start,end]. Controls: axis (dropdown x|y), start (fader), end (fader). Observable scale grows with scroll.

A.name: scrub-morph
A.label: Scrub Morph
A.subject: card
A.description: Scroll scrubs a combined rotate-and-scale morph back and forth — fully scrubbable.
A.behavior: Reads userData.scroll; rotation.y = lerp(0, maxRot, scroll); scale = lerp(1, maxScale, scroll). Bidirectional (scrubbing back reverses). Controls: maxRotDeg (knob), maxScale (fader), wobble (toggle adds a sin). Observable rotation/scale track scroll monotonically.

B.name: scroll-rotate-3d
B.label: Scroll Rotate 3D
B.subject: card
B.description: Scroll tilts the card in 3D, rotating it through depth as it passes.
B.behavior: Reads userData.scroll; rotation.x = lerp(maxTilt, -maxTilt, scroll); slight position.z parallax. Controls: maxTiltDeg (knob), depth (fader z range), axis (dropdown x|y). rotation tracks scroll.

B.name: cursor-trail
B.label: Cursor Trail
B.subject: card
B.description: Card lags toward the pointer with a smooth springy follow, trailing behind fast moves.
B.behavior: Reads userData.pointer {x,y} in 0..1; maps to world offset; lerps current toward target each seek (spring). Controls: stiffness (knob lerp factor), range (fader world units), rotateToward (toggle). position approaches pointer-derived target over repeated seeks. Keep deterministic: state stored on closure.

B.name: parallax-layers
B.label: Parallax Layers
B.subject: card
B.description: Pointer movement shifts the card's chrome layers at different depths for a 3D parallax.
B.behavior: Reads userData.pointer; the card's child chrome (header/dot/rows — traverse children) shift by depth-scaled amounts opposite the pointer; panel shifts least. Controls: strength (knob), invert (toggle), depthSpread (fader). Children offsets differ by depth; observable child.position.x changes with pointer.

B.name: hover-lift
B.label: Hover Lift
B.subject: card
B.description: As the pointer nears, the card lifts toward the viewer, scales up, and brightens.
B.behavior: Reads userData.pointer; proximity = 1 - dist(pointer, center); position.z = proximity*lift; scale = 1+proximity*pop; emissive brightens. Controls: lift (fader), pop (knob), falloff (knob). position.z grows as pointer nears center.

B.name: repel
B.label: Repel
B.subject: card
B.description: The card shies away from the pointer, pushed along the vector from cursor to center.
B.behavior: Reads userData.pointer; vector from pointer to subject; push = strength/(dist+eps) capped; position offset along that vector. Inverse of magnetic. Controls: strength (knob), maxPush (fader), radius (knob). position moves away from pointer.

B.name: typewriter
B.label: Typewriter
B.subject: text
B.description: Glyphs appear one at a time in sequence, like text being typed.
B.behavior: target.subject is a Group of glyph children (subjects.ts text). Each glyph i reveals (scale 0->1 + opacity) when phase passes i/N; a small per-glyph ease. Controls: duration (fader), stagger (knob fraction), cursor (toggle). Observable: number of visible (opacity>0.5) glyphs grows with t. Iterate glyphs via subject.children.

B.name: glitch-text
B.label: Glitch Text
B.subject: text
B.description: Glyphs judder with digital glitch jumps and brief RGB-split offsets before locking in.
B.behavior: Per-glyph deterministic jitter from an index hash (like scramble): position.x/y jumps and a color/emissive flicker keyed to floor(t*rate)+index; amplitude decays to 0 as phase->1 so it locks clean. Controls: duration (fader), intensity (knob), rate (knob). Deterministic (hash, no Math.random). Observable glyph offset differs between early and late phase.

B.name: neon-flicker-text
B.label: Neon Flicker
B.subject: text
B.description: Glyphs buzz on like a neon sign — emissive flickers then holds steady-bright.
B.behavior: Looping or finite: per-glyph emissiveIntensity = base + flicker where flicker is a deterministic noise of (t, index) that is strong early then mostly-on. Controls: speed (knob), flickerDepth (knob), warmup (fader). Track a glyph material emissiveIntensity; restore in dispose. Deterministic.

B.name: wave-text
B.label: Wave Text
B.subject: text
B.description: Glyphs ride a travelling sine wave, bobbing up and down in sequence — a continuous loop.
B.behavior: Looping (Infinity): glyph i position.y = sin(t*speed + i*phaseStep)*amp; optional rotation. Controls: speed (knob), amplitude (fader), wavelength (knob -> phaseStep). Observable glyph.position.y varies by index and time.

B.name: text-extrude
B.label: Text Extrude
B.subject: text
B.description: Glyphs punch forward out of the surface in sequence, gaining depth as they pop in.
B.behavior: Per-glyph staggered: position.z 0 -> depth and scale.z grows (or scale up) with a backOut pop, sequenced by i/N. Controls: duration (fader), depth (fader), stagger (knob). Observable glyph.position.z grows with t in sequence.

B.name: text-cascade
B.label: Text Cascade
B.subject: text
B.description: Glyphs drop in from above one by one, each landing with a little bounce.
B.behavior: Per-glyph staggered drop: glyph i starts at +dropHeight, falls to base with bounceOut when phase passes i/N; opacity rises. Controls: duration (fader), dropHeight (fader), stagger (knob). Observable: glyph.position.y settles in sequence.

B.name: zoom-blur
B.label: Zoom Blur In
B.subject: card
B.description: Card rushes in from an out-of-focus oversized blur, snapping to crisp focus.
B.behavior: Approximated blur (no postprocessing): start scale large (e.g. 1.6) + low opacity + slight per-axis jitter (focus shimmer) -> settle scale 1, opacity 1, jitter 0. Distinct from blur-in by the zoom-from-large + radial jitter. Controls: duration (fader), startScale (fader 1.2..2.5), jitter (knob). Observable scale shrinks and opacity rises.

B.name: iris-wipe
B.label: Iris Wipe
B.subject: card
B.description: A circular iris opens from the center, revealing the card outward — a camera iris.
B.behavior: TSL: swap subject.material to a node material whose opacityNode = step(radius(uv-0.5), uRadius) so a growing circular mask reveals the card; uRadius 0 -> ~0.8 over phase. Use three/tsl (uv, length, step/smoothstep, uniform) and three/webgpu MeshStandardNodeMaterial. Track uRadius.value. Restore prevMat in dispose. Alternatively (if node-material risk) use a CPU scale-from-0 circular proxy via geometry; prefer the TSL alpha mask. Observable uRadius grows.

B.name: flag-wave
B.label: Flag Wave
B.subject: plane
B.description: The plane ripples like a flag in wind, a travelling wave rolling across it.
B.behavior: CPU vertex displacement on the subdivided plane (like wave.ts): z = sin(x*freq + t*speed)*amp * (x normalized so the left edge is pinned). Controls: speed (knob), amplitude (fader), frequency (knob). Modify geometry position attribute in seek; mark needsUpdate; restore base positions in dispose. Observable a vertex z differs between t=0 and t=mid.

B.name: jelly-surface
B.label: Jelly Surface
B.subject: plane
B.description: The plane wobbles like a soft gel, radial jiggle decaying from a poke at center.
B.behavior: CPU vertex displacement: z = sin(dist*freq - t*speed) * amp * exp(-dist*falloff), dist from center; a damped radial jiggle. Controls: speed (knob), amplitude (fader), falloff (knob). Restore base positions in dispose. Distinct from ripple by the gel decay envelope.

B.name: ripple-pool
B.label: Ripple Pool
B.subject: plane
B.description: Multiple raindrop ripples spread across a still pool, overlapping in concentric rings.
B.behavior: CPU vertex displacement from 2-3 fixed drop sources (deterministic positions); each contributes sin(dist*freq - t*speed)*amp*falloff with a per-source time offset so drops start staggered. Controls: speed (knob), amplitude (fader), drops (knob 1..4 count). Sum sources. Restore base in dispose. Distinct from single-center ripple.

B.name: ocean-fft
B.label: Ocean
B.subject: plane
B.description: A rolling ocean surface — several summed Gerstner-style swells of different directions and scales.
B.behavior: CPU vertex displacement summing 3-4 directional sine/Gerstner waves (different dir vectors, freqs, speeds, amplitudes) for a believable choppy ocean; small horizontal Gerstner pinch optional. Controls: choppiness (knob amplitude scale), speed (knob), scale (knob freq scale). Restore base in dispose. Observable z varies across time.

C.name: ink-spread
C.label: Ink Spread
C.subject: plane
C.description: A drop of ink blooms across the surface, an organic stain growing from the center.
C.behavior: TSL on the plane: swap material to MeshBasicNodeMaterial; colorNode/alpha = smoothstep edge of a growing radius (uRadius advanced 0->~0.9 in seek) perturbed by fbm noise of uv for an organic ragged edge; tinted. Use three/tsl + three/webgpu. Track uRadius.value. onParamChange for live controls. Controls: spread speed via duration (fader), edgeNoise (knob), tint (color). Restore prevMat in dispose. Cast nodes like caustics.ts.

C.name: foam
C.label: Foam
C.subject: plane
C.description: Whitewater foam crests drift and dissolve across a water surface.
C.behavior: TSL: colorNode = mix(waterTint, white, foamMask) where foamMask = step(threshold, fbm(uv*scale + drift*t)); animated fbm drift via uTime. Controls: density (knob threshold), speed (knob), tint (color). uTime advanced in seek; uniforms updated. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: dispersion
C.label: Dispersion
C.subject: sphere
C.description: Chromatic dispersion splits the fresnel rim of a glass sphere into shifting RGB fringes.
C.behavior: TSL on the sphere: MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial (three/webgpu) transmissive; build a fresnel via positionViewDirection/normalView dot; add an RGB-split colorNode where R/G/B fresnel powers differ by a uSpread uniform that animates (pulses) over seek. Reference glass-refraction.ts and fresnel-glow.ts patterns. Controls: spread (knob), ior (knob), speed (knob). uSpread/uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose. Note: may read dark on headless — flag for real-GPU.

C.name: refraction-warp
C.label: Refraction Warp
C.subject: sphere
C.description: The glass sphere's refraction warps and breathes, bending the environment behind it.
C.behavior: TSL: MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial transmissive; animate a normalNode perturbation (sin-based ripples over uv/position by uTime) so the refracted background warps; ior/thickness pulse. Controls: warp (knob), speed (knob), ior (knob). Update uniforms in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose. Flag for real-GPU.

C.name: iridescent-glass
C.label: Iridescent Glass
C.subject: sphere
C.description: Soap-bubble thin-film iridescence shimmers over a transmissive sphere, hues shifting with view.
C.behavior: TSL: MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial; add a thin-film style iridescent colorNode driven by fresnel*hueShift(uTime) producing a cycling rainbow sheen on the rim/surface; transmissive base. Controls: hueSpeed (knob), intensity (knob), thickness (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: frosted-glass
C.label: Frosted Glass
C.subject: sphere
C.description: Frost creeps across the glass, a roughness sweep clouding it from clear to frosted and back.
C.behavior: TSL: MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial transmissive; animate roughnessNode from a smoothstep front that sweeps across position.y (or uv) driven by uFront uniform 0->1->0; clear where unfrosted, rough/cloudy where frosted. Controls: speed (knob), frostiness (knob max roughness), grain (knob noise). uFront in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: liquid-glass
C.label: Liquid Glass
C.subject: sphere
C.description: Molten glass blobs flow over the sphere — animated metaball-like normal distortion on a transmissive surface.
C.behavior: TSL: MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial transmissive; normalNode perturbed by summed moving sin lobes (fake metaballs) over position by uTime so highlights flow like liquid; high clearcoat. Controls: flow (knob speed), viscosity (knob lobe scale), ior (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: crystal-facet
C.label: Crystal Facet
C.subject: sphere
C.description: A faceted crystal catches light, sparkle glints racing across sharp facets as it turns.
C.behavior: TSL: MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial; quantize the normal/uv into facets (floor) and add a sharp specular glint = pow(fresnel, high) modulated by a uTime sweep so glints travel; also slowly rotate the subject (rotation.y += in seek) for life. Controls: facets (knob), sparkle (knob), spin (knob). Restore prevMat + rotation in dispose.

C.name: holographic
C.label: Holographic
C.subject: card
C.description: A holographic foil sheen sweeps across the card — rainbow bands shifting with a moving light.
C.behavior: TSL: swap subject.material to MeshStandardNodeMaterial (or Basic) with an additive colorNode = hsv rainbow band of (uv dot dir + uTime) creating diagonal holo bands; blended over a dark base. Controls: speed (knob), bandScale (knob), intensity (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: metallic-sheen
C.label: Metallic Sheen
C.subject: card
C.description: A bright specular band sweeps across a brushed-metal card, like light raking across it.
C.behavior: TSL: colorNode adds a narrow bright band = smoothstep around a moving line position(uTime) along uv.x, tinted; base metallic tint underneath. Controls: speed (knob), width (knob), brightness (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose. Distinct from shimmer reference by the single raking band.

C.name: iridescence
C.label: Oil Slick
C.subject: plane
C.description: An oil-on-water slick of cycling iridescent colors swirls across the plane.
C.behavior: TSL: colorNode = rainbow of (fbm(uv*scale) + uTime*speed) producing swirling oil-slick hues. Use a sin-based hue palette. Controls: speed (knob), scale (knob), saturation (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: sparkle-glints
C.label: Sparkle Glints
C.subject: plane
C.description: Tiny star-like glints twinkle on and off across the surface, like sun on water.
C.behavior: TSL: colorNode adds bright points where a hashed grid cell's twinkle phase (sin(uTime*speed + cellHash*TAU)) exceeds a threshold; sharp pow falloff per cell. Controls: density (knob grid scale), speed (knob), threshold (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose. Deterministic hash.

C.name: caustics-ripple
C.label: Caustics Ripple
C.subject: plane
C.description: A caustic web pulsing in radial ripple rings, like light through disturbed water.
C.behavior: TSL like caustics.ts but modulate the caustic web by a radial ripple term sin(length(uv-0.5)*ringFreq - uTime*speed) so the caustics breathe in rings. Controls: scale (knob), speed (knob), ringFreq (knob), tint (color). uTime in seek + onParamChange. Restore prevMat in dispose. Distinct from caustics by the radial ring modulation.

C.name: underwater-caustics
C.label: Underwater Caustics
C.subject: plane
C.description: Slow, deep-blue caustics with a depth fade — the dappled light of a pool floor.
C.behavior: TSL caustic web (layered sines) tinted deep blue/teal, slower, with a vertical depth gradient darkening the lower area and a soft blue ambient so it reads underwater. Controls: scale (knob), speed (knob), depth (knob gradient), tint (color). uTime in seek + onParamChange. Restore prevMat in dispose.

C.name: shatter
C.label: Shatter
C.subject: plane
C.description: The surface shatters into shards that fly apart and fade — a glass-break transition.
C.behavior: CPU: partition the plane vertices into cells (by floor(uv*grid)); in seek displace each vertex outward along its cell-center direction by phase*spread and add a per-cell rotation-ish jitter + the whole fades (material opacity 1->0). Deterministic per-cell from cell hash. Controls: duration (fader), spread (fader), shards (knob grid). Modify position attribute + opacity; restore in dispose. Observable vertex displacement grows with t.

C.name: pixel-dissolve
C.label: Pixel Dissolve
C.subject: plane
C.description: The surface dissolves block by block in a quantized pixel-grid wipe.
C.behavior: TSL: opacityNode = step(hash(floor(uv*blocks)), uProgress) so blocks vanish in a hashed order as uProgress 0->1; colorNode keeps the tint. Use three/tsl floor/fract/hash + uniform; MeshStandardNodeMaterial transparent. Controls: duration (fader), blocks (knob grid), softness (knob). uProgress in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: melt
D.label: Melt
D.subject: plane
D.description: The surface melts downward in dripping tongues, like wax running off.
D.behavior: CPU vertex displacement: each column (by x) gets a deterministic drip speed (hash of x); position.y -= phase * dripSpeed * columnFactor, with lower verts dripping more; a little x-wobble. Controls: duration (fader), drip (fader max drop), variation (knob). Modify position attribute; restore in dispose. Observable y decreases with t.

D.name: glitch-displace
D.label: Glitch Slice
D.subject: plane
D.description: Horizontal slices of the surface tear and offset in a digital glitch, snapping back to whole.
D.behavior: CPU (or TSL). Prefer CPU vertex: group rows by y-band; each band shifts in x by a deterministic amount keyed to floor(t*rate)+bandHash, amplitude decaying as phase->1 so it heals. Controls: duration (fader), intensity (knob), rate (knob slices/sec). Modify position attribute; restore in dispose. Deterministic. Observable x-offset differs early vs late.

D.name: confetti
D.label: Confetti
D.subject: empty
D.description: A burst of colorful confetti flutters up and rains down with gravity and spin.
D.behavior: subject:'empty' — build THREE.Points (or small instanced quads) into target.object. N particles with deterministic initial velocities (index hash) in a fan; in seek position = p0 + v*t + 0.5*g*t^2; per-particle color from a palette; size attenuation. Controls: count (knob), spread (knob), gravity (knob). Build geometry in build(); update positions BufferAttribute in seek; dispose geometry+material. Deterministic (no random).

D.name: embers
D.label: Embers
D.subject: empty
D.description: Glowing embers rise and flicker upward from a fire, fading as they cool.
D.behavior: empty: Points rising upward with per-particle drift (sin of index+t), additive glowing orange material, brightness/size flicker (hash-based) and fade with height. Looping (Infinity): wrap particles by (t*speed + index) mod 1 for continuous rise. Controls: count (knob), rise (knob speed), drift (knob). Update positions in seek; dispose. Deterministic.

D.name: snow
D.label: Snow
D.subject: empty
D.description: Snowflakes drift gently down, swaying side to side in a continuous fall.
D.behavior: empty: Points falling: y = top - ((t*speed + indexOffset) mod range); x sways by sin(t*swaySpeed + index); soft white round material. Looping (Infinity). Controls: count (knob), fallSpeed (knob), sway (knob). Update positions in seek; dispose. Deterministic.

D.name: bubbles
D.label: Bubbles
D.subject: empty
D.description: Bubbles rise and wobble upward, growing slightly before they pop at the top.
D.behavior: empty: Points rising with a wobble (sin of index+t on x), scale grows with height, fade near top (pop). Looping. Translucent bluish-white additive material. Controls: count (knob), rise (knob), wobble (knob). Update positions/size in seek; dispose. Deterministic.

D.name: fireflies
D.label: Fireflies
D.subject: empty
D.description: Fireflies wander in lazy paths, their warm glow pulsing on and off.
D.behavior: empty: Points wandering on smooth pseudo-noise paths (sums of sins of index-seeded freqs over t); per-particle brightness pulse = sin(t*pulseSpeed + indexPhase) gated; warm yellow-green additive. Looping (Infinity). Controls: count (knob), wander (knob area), pulse (knob). Update positions + per-vertex alpha/size in seek; dispose. Deterministic.

D.name: rain
D.label: Rain
D.subject: empty
D.description: Streaking rain falls fast and straight, slight wind shear across the field.
D.behavior: empty: Points (or thin line segments) falling fast: y = top - ((t*speed + offset) mod range); slight x shear (wind). Cool blue-white, slightly elongated look via size. Looping. Controls: count (knob), speed (knob), wind (knob shear). Update positions in seek; dispose. Deterministic.

D.name: fountain
D.label: Fountain
D.subject: empty
D.description: A fountain jets particles upward in an arc that falls back under gravity.
D.behavior: empty: Points emitted upward with a spread of initial velocities (index hash) ; per-particle life = (t*rate + index) mod 1; position = emit + v*life + 0.5*g*life^2; recycle by life wrap (continuous). Cyan/white. Looping. Controls: count (knob), force (knob up velocity), spread (knob). Update positions in seek; dispose. Deterministic.

D.name: wispy-smoke
D.label: Wispy Smoke
D.subject: plane
D.description: Thin curling wisps of smoke rise and dissipate, slower and softer than billowing smoke.
D.behavior: TSL on plane (like smoke.ts but distinct): colorNode/alpha from layered fbm advected upward (uv.y - uTime*rise) with a horizontal curl (offset uv.x by sin), low density, soft grey, fading toward the top. Controls: rise (knob), curl (knob), density (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: steam
D.label: Steam
D.subject: plane
D.description: Hot steam billows upward in soft translucent plumes that thin as they rise.
D.behavior: TSL: fbm advected upward, brighter/whiter than smoke, with a vertical alpha gradient (dense at base, thin at top) and gentle horizontal sway. Controls: rise (knob), spread (knob), density (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: fire-flame
D.label: Fire
D.subject: plane
D.description: Licking flames rise with a hot gradient from white core to orange to red tips.
D.behavior: TSL: a flame shape = fbm noise advected upward (uv.y - uTime*speed) masked by a vertical flame envelope; color ramp from white/yellow core through orange to red at the flickering tips; alpha fades at top. Controls: speed (knob), height (knob), turbulence (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: clouds
D.label: Clouds
D.subject: plane
D.description: Soft cumulus clouds drift slowly across a sky, billowing as they pass.
D.behavior: TSL: fbm cloud field; alpha = smoothstep(threshold, 1, fbm(uv*scale + drift*uTime)); white over a soft blue; slow drift. Controls: speed (knob), coverage (knob threshold), scale (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: fog
D.label: Fog
D.subject: plane
D.description: Low fog rolls across, soft layered banks thinning and thickening as they pass.
D.behavior: TSL: layered horizontal fbm bands advected sideways (uv.x - uTime*drift) with a vertical density gradient; soft grey, low contrast but not flat. Controls: speed (knob), density (knob), layers (knob scale). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: light-shafts
D.label: Light Shafts
D.subject: plane
D.description: Radial god-ray shafts fan out from a bright point, shimmering as dust drifts through them.
D.behavior: TSL distinct from godray.ts (which is marched parallel shafts): radial shafts from a source point — angle = atan(uv-source); brightness = pow(noise(angle*freq + uTime*speed), k) * radial falloff from source; warm light. Controls: rays (knob freq), speed (knob), spread (knob falloff). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: nebula
D.label: Nebula
D.subject: plane
D.description: A colorful cosmic nebula churns slowly, clouds of violet and cyan lit from within.
D.behavior: TSL: domain-warped fbm (fbm of uv + fbm) producing churning cloud structure; map density to a violet->cyan->magenta palette with bright cores; slow evolution by uTime. Controls: speed (knob), scale (knob), brightness (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.

D.name: plasma
D.label: Plasma
D.subject: plane
D.description: A classic plasma field of interfering sine waves cycling through electric colors.
D.behavior: TSL: v = sin(uv.x*a + uTime) + sin(uv.y*b + uTime) + sin((uv.x+uv.y)*c + uTime) + sin(length(uv-0.5)*d - uTime); map v to a vivid cycling palette (sin-based RGB). Controls: speed (knob), scale (knob a/b/c), saturation (knob). uTime in seek. Restore prevMat in dispose.
